main.description: A Vox Pop creator profile. One record per actor at the well-known `self` rkey, mirroring the `app.bsky.actor.profile` convention.

handle.description: Public handle (e.g. `brad`). Distinct from the AT Protocol handle, which lives on the actor's identity.

rssFeed.description: External podcast feed URL associated with this creator. Today this lives on the user's primary organization, not the user record itself; publishers must source it explicitly.
